title: Foot of the perpendicular and image
back: $Q$ is the point of the line nearest to $P$, with $PQ\perp$ line. The image $P'$ is as far behind the line: $Q$ is the mid-point of $PP'$, so $P'=2Q-P$.

title: Direction cosines
legend: l, m, n = cosines of the angles with the x-, y-, z-axes
back: Equally inclined to the axes: $\pm\dfrac{1}{\sqrt3}$ each. Also $\sin^2\alpha+\sin^2\beta+\sin^2\gamma=2$.

title: From direction ratios to direction cosines
back: Same for $m$ and $n$. Through two points the direction ratios are $x_2-x_1,\ y_2-y_1,\ z_2-z_1$.

title: Line: vector form
legend: a = position vector of a point on the line
b = vector parallel to the line
back: Through two points: $\vec r=\vec a+\lambda(\vec b-\vec a)$.

title: Line: Cartesian form
legend: (x_1, y_1, z_1) = point on the line
back: Read them only after each numerator looks like $x-x_1$ with coefficient $+1$.

title: General point on a line
back: The key to foot of perpendicular, image, intersection of two lines and "where does the line meet the plane $z=0$".

title: Shortest distance: skew lines
tex: d=\left|\dfrac{(\vec a_2-\vec a_1)\cdot(\vec b_1\times\vec b_2)}{|\vec b_1\times\vec b_2|}\right|
back: Join · cross ÷ size of cross. $d=0$ means the lines intersect.

title: Distance between parallel lines
back: Use this when $\vec b_1\times\vec b_2=\vec0$; the skew formula then gives $\dfrac00$.

title: Image of a point in a line
legend: Q = foot of the perpendicular from P
back: Find $Q$ from the general point with $PQ\perp$ line; then double $Q$ and subtract $P$.
